cohort: constrained example-line tuning; legacy pilot excluded
selection_rule: complete without collision, then minimum independently recomputed RMS reference distance; retain all candidates and failures
evaluation_rule: one replay per frozen selection at common zero-offset start; report Gym finish, first geometric crossing, RMS/max reference distance, steering and compute time. No best-lap choice.
constraint_scope: derived target speed profile respects registered 4 m/s^2 lateral, 2 m/s^2 forward, 4 m/s^2 braking; actual closed-loop accelerations and compute deadline remain separate reported checks; tuning does not claim physical compliance or real-time execution
